title: Read together, read aloud
intro: Read a poem to hear its pulse and rhymes. Read story sentences once to work out the words and again to make them sound like talk. Pause at each full stop.
support: نظم په غږ ولولئ او وزن او قافیه یې واورئ. جمله بیا په څرګند غږ ولولئ او په پای کې تم شئ.
text:
Tap, tap, little rain.
Tap, tap, on my pane.
Tap, tap, then the sun.
Tap, tap, rain is done.

On my way home, I see a puddle. I jump over it.
model: Rain and pane rhyme. Tap, tap comes back. A window pane is a sheet of glass. In the story, pause after puddle and then read the next sentence.
activity: Clap the repeated beat with a partner. Cover the poem and say a line. Read both story sentences independently.
adult: Read the poem to the learner, then invite joining the repeated words. Listen to an unaided reading of a fresh short text and observe expression and stops.
adultPs: نظم ماشوم ته ولولئ. ماشوم دې تکراري کلمې درسره ووایي. نوې لنډه لیکنه دې په خپله ولولي؛ غږ او تم کېدل یې واورئ.

tasks: Point to a word that is repeated. Read it with a partner.
Circle rain and pane. Say what you notice about their ends.
Draw the picture the first two lines suggest.
Read the poem with an adult and tap its rhythm on a table.
Read the puddle sentences twice. Mark where you pause.
Choose a familiar rhyme to say with someone at home.
Read the puddle sentences independently. Tell which word you read more fluently the second time.
Recite two lines of the rain poem. Show the rhythm as you say them.
Read aloud: The rain stops. A bird sings. Pause at the full stops.
Tell how the repetition helps you join the poem. Draw the scene and explain one detail.
